# Disagreement Log — GTH_103

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 103
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 103 | "Blessed" | "Blessed" | "Fortunate" | Beatitude formula: *makarios* — blessed vs. fortunate |
| 2 | 103 | "brigands" | "bandits" | "robbers" | *lēstai*: brigands vs. bandits vs. robbers |
| 3 | 103 | "gather his domain" | "collect his belongings" | "pull everything together" | *agorā*: domain/household vs. belongings |
| 4 | 103 | "before they enter" | "before they arrive" | "before they come in" | Timing: entry vs. arrival |

**Total disagreements: 4**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "Blessed" (traditional beatitude), "brigands" (most elevated for *lēstai*), "gather his domain" (preserves the scope of *agorā*), and "before they enter" (matching the entry verb of the first clause).
